facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Mother's Day gift event in which all new and existing players could receive an in-game bouquet of roses using a redeem code.
facts.quote: giving all new and existing players an in-game bouquet of roses to show your mom

article_summaries.title: Roses For Mothers Day!
article_summaries.summary: A May 2009 Free Realms news post announcing a Mother's Day promotion: a redeemable code gives all new and existing players an in-game bouquet of roses. The item is claimed through the Station Cash store, goes to the weapon slot, and is no-trade and limited to one per account. The page gives no posting date; it was posted about 4 days 19 hours before the May 13, 2009 capture.
